method: 100 exact quoted article searches, a stratified sample of eight live catalog sections, then selected source-page review. Additional searches and a manufacturer document were used for examples.

reviewedCases.notes: Exact part number and a dedicated application list are visible on the seller page. Chery Omoda 5 is normalized to OMODA C5. Engines and years listed by the seller have not been validated. The number also occurs in the CHERY T1E 2020 manual, PDF page 137.
The supplier listing has exact number 302001163AA and a model field VX/TXL/TX. The user's VX FL MY2024+ rule must not be used to infer that this part fits all VX versions.

The original individual listing redirects to a part-number collection. A seller's listing on that page explicitly names these eight models. The page heading calls it a bolt, while the listing and our name describe a brake-pad spring/clip: do not copy the collection's part type.

The first page lists exact article and these vehicle families. Its ambiguous Pro/Max shorthand was not expanded into extra models. AUTODOC lists alternatives/crosses, which are distinct from confirmed OEM fitment.

The supplier page contains M118103010BE / M11-8103010BE and OMODA S5. Other models found in search results require separate review. The domain is recorded as a supplier, without asserting an affiliation with another company named HELLA.
The search result suggests J5/J7/OMODA 5, but the opened page does not expose the exact 206000119AB number. No reviewed vehicle relationship was accepted from this page.
